title: Khu đón ở đâu?
summary: Khu đón ở đâu? means “Where is the pickup area?”

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Say Khu đón ở đâu? when you need "Where is the pickup area". Use this for rideshare, shuttle, or private pickup handoffs. This keeps the first transport handoff from going messy. Use the rows below to pick the warmer, safer, or more direct version.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: This pattern asks where a place or service is. Swap the first part to ask about another nearby stop.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Use Khu đón ở đâu? as your first sentence for "Where is the pickup area". Use this for rideshare, shuttle, or private pickup handoffs. Pause after the phrase and listen for a point, short direction, nearby option, or counter name. Keep your passport, visa, baggage tag, pickup message, or SIM details visible when staff need to match the phrase to a real item.

sections.title: Natural variations
sections.body: This form changes the tone or setting. Use it when the note under the phrase matches the moment.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi gặp tài xế ở đâu?
phrases.english: Where do I meet the driver?
phrases.pronunciation: toy gap tai seh uh dow

sections.title: Why it matters
sections.body: Airport phrases help staff route you to the next counter or service without a long explanation. For "Where is the pickup area", Khu đón ở đâu? makes the next step easier to answer. If the answer is longer than a point or nearby stop, ask them to show it on your phone.

sections.title: Traveler insight
sections.body: In Airport Border Arrival, the reply often comes as a point, short direction, nearby option, or counter name. Say Khu đón ở đâu? once, pause, and watch for the reply. Keep your passport, visa, baggage tag, pickup message, or SIM details visible when staff need to match the phrase to a real item.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use this for rideshare, shuttle, or private pickup handoffs. It fits arrival, immigration, baggage, SIM cards, pickup, and airport services, especially when the next step is a point, short direction, nearby option, or counter name. If the answer is longer than a point or nearby stop, ask them to show it on your phone.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Airport staff may answer by pointing. Follow the gesture first, then ask again if the next step is still unclear.

sections.title: Local tip
sections.body: Keep your passport, baggage tag, or booking screen visible while you ask.
